value.behaviour: Stores the encrypted page list next to the encrypted elements in the Firebase room and restores it on load, keeping legacy rooms loadable.
rules: `FirebaseStoredScene` gains optional `pagesCiphertext?: Bytes` and `pagesIv?: Bytes`.

A private `encryptPages(key, pages)` / `decryptPages(data, roomKey)` pair mirrors encryptElements/decryptElements; `decryptPages` returns `restorePages(JSON)` when both fields exist, else `restorePages(undefined)` (the default page).
`createFirebaseSceneDocument(elements, pages, roomKey)` also writes `pagesCiphertext` and `pagesIv`.

`saveToFirebase(portal, elements, appState)` saves `appState.pages`; for an existing document it reconciles elements as today and pages with `reconcilePages(appState.pages, await decryptPages(prevStoredScene, roomKey))`; it returns `{ elements: RemoteExcalidrawElement[]; pages: ExcalidrawPage[] } | null` where pages come from decrypting the stored document.

`isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, pages?)` compares the cached value with `getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages ?? [])`; `FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, elements, pages)` stores the same sum.
`loadFromFirebase` returns `{ elements: readonly SyncableExcalidrawElement[]; pages: ExcalidrawPage[] } | null`, with pages from `decryptPages`.
`getPagesVersion`, `reconcilePages` and `restorePages` are imported from `@excalidraw/element` (extend the `getSceneVersion` import); `ExcalidrawPage` is added to the element type import.
